title: PDFino – AI PDF Editor
description: A modern AI-powered PDF editor that allows users to merge, split, compress, convert, organize, protect, unlock, watermark, rotate, and manage PDF files with a beautiful, responsive interface.
overview: PDFino is a comprehensive web-based PDF utility suite designed to streamline document workflows without requiring heavy desktop software. Built primarily for students, professionals, and small businesses, the platform offers fast, secure, and intuitive PDF manipulation tools. The main objective was to create a privacy-first, high-performance editor that processes documents directly in the browser wherever possible, minimizing server round-trips and ensuring maximum security for sensitive user data.

challenges.title: Large File Handling
challenges.description: Processing PDFs over 50MB in the browser caused severe main-thread blocking, leading to UI freezes and a poor user experience.

challenges.title: Privacy & Security
challenges.description: Users are hesitant to upload sensitive legal or financial documents to third-party servers for simple tasks like merging or splitting.

challenges.title: Complex State Management
challenges.description: Managing the state of multiple uploaded files, their individual processing statuses, and the final combined output required a robust architecture.

solutions.title: Web Workers Implementation
solutions.description: Migrated all heavy PDF manipulation tasks (using pdf-lib) to dedicated Web Workers. This kept the UI thread running at 60fps even during complex document processing.

solutions.title: Client-Side First Processing
solutions.description: Engineered the platform to perform 90% of operations entirely in the browser. Documents only touch the server when utilizing specific AI analysis features.

solutions.title: Custom Zustand Store
solutions.description: Implemented a centralized, atomic state management solution using Zustand to track individual file progress, error boundaries, and output blobs efficiently.

title: Next Class Quiz
description: A modern online examination platform for schools, colleges, coaching institutes, and training organizations featuring secure quizzes, real-time results, and a clean admin dashboard.
overview: Next Class Quiz is an end-to-end educational assessment platform designed to modernize the way institutions conduct examinations. Traditional testing methods are time-consuming to grade and difficult to secure remotely. This platform solves those issues by providing teachers with an intuitive quiz builder and giving students a distraction-free, secure testing environment with instant automated grading and analytics.

challenges.title: Real-time Synchronization
challenges.description: Ensuring that exam timers and submission states remained accurate even if a student lost internet connection temporarily.

challenges.title: Anti-Cheating Mechanisms
challenges.description: Building a secure environment that prevents tab-switching or copy-pasting during active examinations.

challenges.title: Concurrent Scaling
challenges.description: Handling sudden spikes in database reads/writes when an entire class of 100+ students submits their exams simultaneously at the deadline.

solutions.title: Local Storage Fallback
solutions.description: Implemented a robust offline-first synchronization system that caches answers locally and syncs them to Firestore once the connection is restored.

solutions.title: Visibility API Integration
solutions.description: Utilized the Page Visibility API to track and warn students when navigating away from the active exam window.

solutions.title: Batched Writes
solutions.description: Optimized Firestore interactions using batched writes and localized the grading logic to highly concurrent Cloud Functions to prevent bottlenecking.

title: EventHub – Event Management Platform
description: A complete event management platform for creating, managing, and booking events with an intuitive admin dashboard and modern user experience.
overview: EventHub is a comprehensive full-stack application designed to remove the friction from event planning and ticketing. Built for organizers handling everything from small meetups to large-scale tech conferences, it replaces fragmented spreadsheets with a unified dashboard. The primary goal was to create a seamless booking flow for attendees while providing powerful analytics and management tools for organizers.

challenges.title: Complex Data Relationality
challenges.description: Managing the complex relationships between Users, Events, Tickets, and Organizers within a NoSQL database like MongoDB.

challenges.title: Booking Race Conditions
challenges.description: Preventing double-booking when multiple users attempt to purchase the final available tickets for a popular event simultaneously.

challenges.title: Image Optimization
challenges.description: Handling high-resolution event banner uploads without bloating the server storage or drastically increasing page load times for users.

solutions.title: Mongoose Population
solutions.description: Designed a heavily normalized NoSQL schema relying on strict referencing and optimized Mongoose `.populate()` queries to maintain data integrity.

solutions.title: Atomic Operations
solutions.description: Implemented atomic MongoDB updates (`$inc`, `$set`) alongside application-level locking mechanisms during the checkout flow to strictly guarantee ticket availability.

solutions.title: Cloudinary Pipeline
solutions.description: Integrated a direct-to-cloud upload pipeline using Cloudinary, automatically compressing and transforming images on the fly before serving them via CDN.
